title: Fixed Open Bed Slotted Rail and Locked Composing Knee
description: One newly authored complete empty fixed composing-stick-inspired hand tool. A single continuous thin grounded bed carries a fixed end lip and a long back rail with ten genuine enclosed through slots. One complete transverse knee crosses the open shallow bed and joins an upper and rear sleeve around that rail. A full vertical lock pin, round pivot boss and chamfered flat locking lever establish the single fixed position. The wide front and opposite end remain genuinely open. This is not the old two-wall mitre box with new colours or a resized corner vise: the shallow one-sided type bed, pierced back rail and wrapping cross-bed knee are wholly newly authored numeric geometry. One model zero scenes, four opaque constant PBR roles, metres and native Z up. Empty fixed visual appearance only: no actual type, text, calibrations, sliding adjustment, precision, locking force, printing performance, historical reconstruction, manufacture or safety capability. No rig, animation or interaction.
